; v0.4: (shape Name …), (takes Shape [:as name] [sketch]) and (gives Shape …). Default names, :as, the 0.3 and 0.2 forms (read, and reported), clashes.
(shape NoteSaved (~ A note reached the disk. ~))
(shape Item)
(shape URL)
(shape shell.Intent)
(shape List<Item>)
(shape Élan)
(behavior Feed (gives Item (~ The next item. ~)))
(behavior Other (gives Item))
(behavior Both (implements Feed) (implements Other))
(behavior Echo (implements Feed) (takes Item))
(behavior (Store T) (takes T) (gives T :as get))
(block Notes
  (level
    (block Notes.Editor
      (takes NoteSaved (~ Refresh the preview after a save. ~))
      (gives Item)
      (takes Item :as backlog)
      (takes URL)
      (takes shell.Intent)
      (takes List<Item>)
      (takes Élan)
      (takes Item :as item2 (sketch "Named explicitly."))))
  (level
    (block Notes.Store (implements (Store Item)) (gives NoteSaved) (takes Item :as feed))
    (block Notes.Legacy
      (port chord in Item)
      (port item out Item (~ Same name as the default. ~))
      (port saved in NoteSaved))
    (block Notes.Old
      (port :in Item)
      (port :out NoteSaved :as done (~ The 0.3 form, with a name and a sketch. ~)))))
(message OldShape (~ The 0.3 name for a shape. ~))
(block Clash
  (takes Item)
  (gives Item)
  (implements Feed))
(block Twice (implements Feed) (implements Other))
(block ViaBoth (implements Both))
(block Bad
  (takes)
  (gives :as x)
  (port in Item)
  (port :sideways Item)
  (takes Item extra)
  (takes Item :as x (sketch "a") (sketch "b")))
